description.value:
A thin, fleshy membrane stretches between your front and hind limbs. You can spread your patagium as a single Interact action as long as you aren't encumbered or wearing heavy armor. While your patagium is spread, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet, but you can't gain altitude using this fly Speed and must descend at least 1 foot for every 5 feet you move horizontally.

Activate—Emergency Spread r

Trigger You fall at least 10 feet

Requirements You aren't encumbered or wearing heavy armor

Effect You Interact to spread your patagium, arresting your fall. If you hit the ground before the start of your next turn, you take no damage from falling.

Activate—Airbrake r

Trigger You would be moved by a forced movement effect other than falling

Effect You snap your patagium open, arresting your momentum. You're moved only 5 feet by the triggering effect.
